usageNotes: Use this to retrieve the IP address or CIDR definition of a specific cluster-level firewall alias by its name. The alias name must start with a letter and match the pattern [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9\-\_]+. Requires Sys.Audit privilege at the root path; API tokens are supported.

examples.summary: Fetch the definition of a firewall alias named 'WebServers'

tips: Alias names are case-sensitive; 'webservers' and 'WebServers' are distinct entries.
Cluster-level aliases (this endpoint) are available to all nodes; node-level aliases live under /nodes/{node}/firewall/aliases/{name}.
Use list_cluster_firewall_aliases (GET /cluster/firewall/aliases) to discover valid alias names before calling this endpoint.
